meta.name: prisma-mongodb-upgrade
meta.description: Decision and migration guide for Prisma ORM MongoDB projects on v6, which have no upgrade path to v7. Use when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" comes up in a project with provider = "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma Next. Triggers on "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", "mongodb prisma migration", "prisma next mongodb".

copy.tagline: 规划 MongoDB 项目在 Prisma 升级受阻时的迁移路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的 MongoDB 项目 Prisma 停在 v6,升级无路。
copy.tagline_en: Chart a migration path for MongoDB projects stuck on Prisma v6
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a MongoDB project on Prisma v6 and need a way to move forward.

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude在遇到MongoDB项目想升级Prisma时，给出明确答复：不能升级到Prisma 7，只能选择迁移到Prisma Next（仍在早期测试）或继续留在当前v6版本，并解释各自利弊和具体操作步骤。
howto.when: 当用户提到升级Prisma、Prisma 7 MongoDB、MongoDB迁移等关键词，或询问是否迁移到Prisma Next时触发。

say.text: 我的项目用MongoDB，能升级到Prisma 7吗？
say.note: Claude会说明v7没有MongoDB支持，并给出选择。

say.text: 帮我评估从Prisma 6迁移到Prisma Next的步骤。
say.note: Claude会给出迁移指南和检查清单。
Claude会给出留用v6的卫生建议。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude respond to MongoDB projects asking about Prisma upgrades with a clear decision: Prisma 7 has no MongoDB connector, so the only paths are migrating to Prisma Next (Early Access) or staying on v6. It explains trade-offs and provides migration mechanics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" appears with provider "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma Next. Keywords include "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", etc.

say_en.text: My project uses MongoDB, can I upgrade to Prisma 7?
say_en.note: Claude will explain v7 lacks MongoDB support and present options.

say_en.text: Help me evaluate migrating from Prisma 6 to Prisma Next.
say_en.note: Claude will provide migration guide and checklist.

say_en.text: I want to stay on Prisma 6, how do I maintain it?
say_en.note: Claude will give v6 stay-hygiene advice.
